news.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
news.summary: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

news.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
news.summary: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

news.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
news.summary: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

news.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
news.summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

news.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
news.summary: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

news.title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
news.summary: BTC's sell-off deepened on Saturday, with prices hitting two-year lows under $57,000.

news.title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
news.summary: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.

news.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
news.summary: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

news.title: My husband is happily retired at 64 and thinks I should keep working. Is he being fair?
news.summary: “I’m exhausted. My alarm goes off at 6 a.m., and I have a 50-minute commute.”

news.title: My wife is bankrolling her family’s trips to New York and it’s draining our savings. Should I ask her to stop?
news.summary: “Hotel rooms can cost as much as $400 per night.”

news.title: I’m in my 40s. Should I accept a lower pension in exchange for naming my husband or child as a beneficiary?
news.summary: “If I die before my husband, he will receive a lifetime pension equal to 50%–66% of my monthly benefit.”

news.summary: “It is devastating when the people you should be able to trust become the very people you have to protect yourself from.”

news.title: ‘I’ve been a stay-at-home mom’: I’m 50 and have a chronic illness. My husband lost his job. Should he raid his 401(k)?
news.summary: “Our financial and healthcare situation has become increasingly concerning.”

news.title: ‘Buyers are out for blood’: With home sales at a record low, buyers are calling the shots
news.summary: The few buyers left in the market braving record-high home prices and 7% mortgage rates are starting to call the shots, real-estate agents say.
